name: eufy Smart Lock E30 (US)

radios.note: CSA and eufy describe Matter over Thread plus built-in Wi-Fi for the eufy app and remote control. No source we found confirms a Bluetooth radio for this model, so it is not listed.

matter.note: CSA lists the eufy Smart Lock E30 from Anker Innovations (Matter 1.2, certified 2024-07-02, firmware V1.0.0.0, hardware V3). It is Matter over Thread, not over Wi-Fi.

apple_home.note: Matter over Thread. eufy says iOS 18 can add Matter devices without a hub and iPhone 15 Pro or later can control Thread devices directly, but remote control needs a HomePod mini, HomePod or Apple TV 4K as hub.

google_home.note: eufy documents linking the eufy account through Works with Google for the C34/E30, with a 4-digit code for voice unlock. Matter over Thread also works with a Matter-capable Nest hub.

alexa.note: eufy documents linking the eufy account in the Alexa app for the C34/E30, with an optional voice PIN for unlocking. Matter over Thread also works with a Matter-enabled Echo.

smartthings.note: eufy's product page lists SmartThings; its Matter FAQ says a SmartThings hub that supports Matter is needed, with a Thread border router.

home_assistant.note: No Home Assistant docs page for this lock found. As a Matter-over-Thread lock it may work through the Matter integration with a Thread border router, but no official source confirms it.

hubRequired.note: Built-in Wi-Fi connects the lock to the eufy app without a bridge. Each Matter platform needs its own Matter controller with a Thread border router, and Apple Home remote control needs a home hub.

localControl.note: No eufy source describes local-only control explicitly.

lockFit.note: Replaces a standard US deadbolt and keeps a physical keyhole for the mechanical key.

keypad.note: Keypad on the lock, plus a fingerprint reader.

power.note: eight AA batteries; eufy claims up to 8 months per set.

summary: Matter over Thread brings the eufy Smart Lock E30 into Apple Home and SmartThings. Alexa and Google Home connect by linking your eufy account. It is a US deadbolt replacement with a keypad, fingerprint reader and a keyhole for a mechanical key, powered by eight AA batteries. Home Assistant is not confirmed.
caveats: Matter control needs a Thread border router: a HomePod mini or Apple TV 4K, a Matter-capable Nest hub or Echo, or a Matter-capable SmartThings hub.
Apple Home remote control needs a home hub, even though iOS 18 can add the lock without one.
